m.s: Heat the oven to 220°C. Cut {potato} into thin fries and toss with oil, salt and chopped {rosemary} on a lined tray. Roast for 35 to 40 minutes, turning halfway, until golden and crisp.
Thinly slice {onion}. Cook in a drizzle of oil with a pinch of salt over low heat for 20 minutes, stirring often, until soft and jammy. Stir in {brownsugar} for the last 2 minutes.
Slice {pickles} into rounds and finely chop a spoonful of them. Mix the chopped pickles with {mayo}, {ketchup} and {mustard}.

Roll {wagyu} into 100g balls and keep them cold until you cook. Heat a heavy frying pan or BBQ plate over high heat until smoking. Add a ball, smash it flat with a sturdy spatula and season well. Cook for 2 minutes without touching it until a deep crust forms.
Scrape under the patty to keep the crust, flip, and lay a cheese slice on top (you'll use {slices} in all). Cook for 1 more minute. Stack two patties together and repeat.
Toast {buns} cut side down. Spread with the sauce, then add {cos}, the double patty, onion and pickles. Serve with the fries.

l: Patties and onion over shredded lettuce with the sauce on the side. Skip the bun. Keeps 3 days in the fridge.
g: GF buns, and cook the GF patties first on a clean surface. Check the mustard and pickles.
